5900-7173-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
5900-7173-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

1008-1978-2750.easyPrerequisites: Undermountain Adventurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
1008-1978-2750.description:
Cause Undermountain Adventurer to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Undermountain Adventurer by tapping it, adding six {G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Undermountain Adventurer.
Repeat from step 2.

2169-3967-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-3967-4694-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-6972-7511.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Grimgrin abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
728-6972-7511.notes: If Witch-king starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

4681-4894-6495-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.
4681-4894-6495-6542.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2946-4556-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4556-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

206-630-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
206-630-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

3497-4907-5147-6989.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 3 life this turn.
3497-4907-5147-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4460-5299-5921-5970--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
4460-5299-5921-5970--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
4460-5299-5921-5970--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

1074-4222-5268.description:
Activate King Macar by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do so.
Repeat.

1680-3767-3918-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
1680-3767-3918-5527.description:
Activate Trazyn using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1617-4831-4983-5358-6618.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
You have enough mana to cast Relm's Sketching.
1617-4831-4983-5358-6618.description:
Cast Relm's Sketching by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
1617-4831-4983-5358-6618.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

880-3470-6529.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

465-2079-3742-4251-4875.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-2079-3742-4251-4875.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

372-2556-4598.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Essence Flux exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Mnemonic Wall exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
372-2556-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Mnemonic Wall and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Mnemonic Wall trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Mnemonic Wall and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1741-4013-4878.easyPrerequisites: Market Festival attached a mana-producing land you control.
1741-4013-4878.notablePrerequisites: You control a land that can tap to produce at least {C}.
1741-4013-4878.description:
Activate a land and the land with Market Festival attached if it isn't the same land by tapping it, adding at least {C}.
Market Festival triggers, adding {2}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the land(s) tapped in step 1.
Repeat.
1741-4013-4878.notes: If Market Festival is attached to a land that can produce {C} and/or you control a land that can add multiple mana, you may then untap other lands using Cloud of Faeries' ETB ability.

169-2773-2825-3152.notablePrerequisites:
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
It is your turn.
169-2773-2825-3152.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {0} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pact of the Titan without paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Resolve Pact of the Titan, creating a 4/4 Giant creature token.When the Giant enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing damage equal to the Giant's power to any target.
Repeat.

803-876-2525-4302-4951.notablePrerequisites:
"Angel" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
Your life total is at least four.
803-876-2525-4302-4951.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Priest of Fell Rites.
Activate Priest of Fell Rites by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it.
When Priest of Fell Rites dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Resolve the Priest of Fell Rites ability, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Priest of Fell Rites.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Body Double.
Activate Body Double by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it.
 When Body Double dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Resolve the Body Double ability, returning Priest of Fell Rites from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Fell Rites enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Repeat.

1379-3698-3764.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
The Pincher enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth, triggering Grinding Station, untapping it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

3774-4013-4110.notablePrerequisites:
Luxior attached to Gideon.
You control creatures that can tap to produce at least {2}{C}.
3774-4013-4110.description:
Activate creatures by tapping them, adding at least {3}{C}.
Activate Gideon's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Gideon.
Activate Luxior's first equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Gideon.
Repeat.

1703-1872.notablePrerequisites: Fool's Demise attached to Composite Golem.
1703-1872.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Composite Golem dies, triggering Fool's Demise first and second abilities.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Composite Golem from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Fool's Demise by paying {4}{U}, attaching it to Composite Golem.
Repeat.

565-914-2450.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
565-914-2450.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist.
The token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, changing nothing and returning it to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you can target any permanents you control in step 1 to create infinite token copies of them.

1988-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of the Bloodchief attached to any creature you control.
You control at least one additional artifact.
1988-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any other artifact you control, adding {C}{C}.
Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it is attached to.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on the creature with Blade of the Bloodchief attached, you may activate Blade of the Bloodchief's equip ability, attaching it to another creature you control.
If you do, you may repeat step 5 for each creature you control.

335-4551.description:
Cast Ad Nauseam by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Resolve Ad Nauseam, revealing the top card of your library, putting that card into your hand and losing life equal to that card's mana value.
Repeat the process in step 2 as many times as desired.
